ladder.age_line: ⏱ DOWNTREND signal triggered 9 trading days ago (~2026-06-02), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: strong (score -80/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 下跌趋势信号于 9 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-02），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：强（评分 -80/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：强卖出/离场形态（-60）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✓ · 3日 ✓ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 —
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_knife_line: ⚠ Deep washout — price is 18% below its 200-day, a broken primary trend. Measured: setups this stretched below the 200-day held the cycle low only ~37% of the time and drew a ~−22% tail (violent bounces, rarely the durable low). Treat as knife-risk — wait for it to reclaim the 10-day average and size small. The score above is already tempered for this.
ladder.bc_knife_line_zh: ⚠ 深度超卖——价格较 200 日均线低约 18%（主趋势已破）。实测：如此远低于 200 日线的形态，仅约 37% 守住周期低点，且回撤尾部约 −22%（反弹猛烈，但很少是持久低点）。视为「接飞刀」风险——等其收复 10 日均线后再小仓参与。上方分数已据此打折。

profile.description: Netflix, Inc. is an American media company founded on August 29, 1997, by Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph in Scotts Valley, California, and currently based in Los Gatos, California, with production offices and stages at the Los Angeles-based Hollywood studios and the Albuquerque Studios.
profile.description_zh: 奈飞公司是一家美国媒体公司，由里德·哈斯廷斯和马克·伦道夫于1997年8月29日在加利福尼亚州斯科茨谷创立，现总部位于加利福尼亚州洛斯加托斯，在洛杉矶好莱坞片场和阿尔伯克基影城设有制作办公室和摄影棚。
